title: All unmanaged attach and runtime mutation paths fail closed
blocker: The E3 QMP component gate covers one command channel only; production API, raw QEMU CLI, storage or definition mutation, alternate monitor sockets, fd injection, launcher privilege separation and durable lease/admission integration remain unimplemented.
assertions: an unmanaged request cannot launch or mutate a DirectPath QEMU process without an admitted durable lease
API, CLI, QMP, storage, alternate-monitor and fd-injection bypass attempts fail before backend mutation
replay and concurrency do not change assignment generation, lease, VFIO fds or guest topology
every production denial is tied to peer identity, policy hash and request digest without logging raw secrets
